== Biography ==
Brian Alejo Distefano is from Caseros, Buenos Aires, Argentina.

== Trivia ==
* Achieved two pentakills as {{ci|Smolder}} in the same game playing for [[Estral Esports]] against [[All Knights]] in the [[LLA 2024 Opening|week 7 of the LLA 2024 Opening]].
* Was nicknamed "Luskkão" by [[Ilha das Lendas]] during the [[LTA South 2025 Split 1|LTA]] due to his physical similarity to [[Luskka|a retired Brazilian player who runs by that nickname]].
=== Individual Awards ===
* LLA player with the most MVPs in the split x2 (Opening 2024, Closing 2024)
